mcqs.question: What is the annual target of new units under Andhra Pradesh’s proposed Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP)?
options: Up to ₹75 lakh per manufacturing unit
Up to ₹25 lakh per service unit
mcqs.explanation: The proposed CMEGP targets 5,000–6,000 new units every year. The figure of ₹75 lakh refers to the ceiling for a manufacturing unit, while ₹25 lakh is the ceiling for a service unit and ₹50 lakh is the PMEGP manufacturing ceiling.
